posts.text:
Built in 1852, Cambria Iron Works 
in Johnstown is one of the oldest steel plants. It become Bethlehem Steel in 1923. After the mills closed in 1992, over 12,000 workers lost their jobs.

Trump promised to bring steel back to Johnstown. He did not deliver. My Steel Modernization bill calls for an investment in 8 modern steel plants in deindustrialized towns like Johnstown.

Jeanne Gibson , who was the iconic Rosie the Riveter, died this past Thursday. She was a welder who helped build destroyers in Seattle. 

She was a national hero, and our nation should honor her life.

It is a commentary on our times and the click-bait economy that we have not paused to reflect on her and her generation's extraordinary sacrifices that built our nation.
posts.summary: Honors working-class hero, critiques media's failure to reflect on legacy
